content: There are various types of insulin plans recommended by the American Diabetes Association (ADA). Continuous insulin infusion plans involve the use of an insulin pump to deliver a steady basal rate of insulin throughout the day. This approach helps to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia by maintaining consistent insulin levels. Additionally, automated insulin pumps that integrate with continuous glucose monitoring systems are available. These advanced systems can improve blood glucose management by adjusting insulin delivery based on real-time glucose readings. However, they may come with higher financial costs.
